prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash, injuries, insurance issues, and whether you want to settle quickly or prepare to go to trial. I can help you find good options, but I’ll need a little more about your situation to give tailored recommendations.

Quick questions
- Where in Houston are you located (ZIP or neighborhood)?
- When did the accident happen?
- Were there serious injuries? Any hospitalizations or permanent impairment?
- Do you know who’s at fault and what the insurance situation looks like?
- Do you want a lawyer who tries cases in court, or do you prefer a lawyer who focuses on negotiating settlements?

How to pick the best lawyer for your case
Look for these attributes:
- Focused experience: they regularly handle car-accident personal injury claims (not just general practice).
- Trial experience: a lawyer who wins at trial usually gets better offers in settlements.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Houston courts, judges, and insurers.
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts for similar injuries and credible client reviews.
- Clear communication: they return calls, explain strategy, and give realistic outcomes.
- Fee structure: most work on contingency (commonly ~33%–40% of the recovery). Ask about costs and whether they advance litigation expenses.
- Good references/peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell, AVVO, Super Lawyers, Texas Trial Lawyers Association).

Important practical tips / red flags
- Ask for recent comparable case results.
- Confirm who will handle the case day-to-day (partner vs. junior associate).
- Red flags: no written retainer, pressure to sign immediately, unwillingness to put estimates/fees in writing, poor communication during the first contact.
- Statute of limitations in Texas: generally 2 years from the accident date for personal injury claims — act promptly.

Where to search and verify credentials
- State Bar of Texas lawyer search (to verify license and discipline history)
- Texas Trial Lawyers Association (lists experienced trial lawyers)
- Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Google/Google Maps reviews
- Local referral from family/friends or hospital case managers

If you want, I can:
- Suggest several well-reviewed Houston personal injury attorneys/firms near you (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood), or
- Draft a short list of questions you can use in consultations, or
- Help evaluate intake materials or an offer you’ve received.

Which would you prefer?
